name: First MTP Osteoarthritis / Hallux Rigidus
definition: Osteoarthritis of the first metatarsophalangeal joint causing pain, stiffness and loss of dorsiflexion during gait.

investigations.radiographs: Weight-bearing foot radiographs demonstrate OA and osteophytes.

amber: Injection or surgery depends on severity and functional impairment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Sandhigata Vata correlation may be documented with modern MTP OA diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Osteoarthritis of the first metatarsophalangeal joint causing pain, stiffness and loss of dorsiflexion during gait.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
